items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: No, I didn't know Clancy personally. ... But I never did meet

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. And Clancy, did you know Clancy?

No, I didn't know Clancy personally. I know his niece. His niece often claims that her mother played that tune, It's Too Late to Be Sorry, that's Joe Burgess, I'm Sorry I Made You Cry. She said that her mother had that tune before her uncle had it. Of course, that starts one of those controversies again as to who it really belonged to, you know. But I never did meet, that was Joe Clessie, wasn't it?
